summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and added tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (39 passed) under the shared venv. Not committed. Not verified: mypy and black are not installed in the venv, so the type-check and formatting gates were not run; I checked line lengths (all within 88) and placed type-ignore comments by reading the code. The empty-sequence branch is not separately tested because sh:path () hits the rdf:nil branch instead.
